components.name: Primary Tag Button
components.description: Sharp 0px terracotta tag CTA for storefront conversion actions.
components.css: .ds-tag-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:0.62rem 1.2rem; border-radius:0; border:1px solid #C4553A; background:#C4553A; color:#FBF8F1; font-family:'Archivo',sans-serif; font-size:0.75rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.09em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-tag-btn:hover { background:#A6422A; border-color:#A6422A; } .ds-tag-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #C4553A; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Canopy Button
components.description: Deep ceremonial green button for bag/checkout and admin confirmation actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-canopy { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:0.62rem 1.2rem; border-radius:0; border:1px solid #1C3127; background:#1C3127; color:#FBF8F1; font-family:'Archivo',sans-serif; font-size:0.75rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.09em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-canopy:hover { background:#254033; } .ds-btn-canopy:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #C4553A; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Editorial Input Field
components.description: Zero-radius crisp ink-bordered form field using monospace tasting/data voice.

narrative.overview: Café Isla pairs the unhurried editorial print-zine warmth of Flora Wellness Cafe with sunlit Philippine coastal materials: abaca parchment paper, honed travertine limestone, ceremonial matcha canopy greens, and roasted espresso ink linework.
keyCharacteristics: Sharp 0px architectural framing across every photograph, button, input, drawer, and card
Three-voice typography pairing italic Caslon display/serif prose, tracked uppercase Archivo UI chrome, and Courier Prime tasting notes and tabular numbers
Restrained warm paper palette anchored by deep canopy green (#1C3127) and terracotta clay (#C4553A)

rules.name: The Sharp-Edge Material Rule
rules.body: No rounded SaaS pills or floating soft shadows appear on photographic frames, cards, or primary CTAs; structural hierarchy comes strictly from 1px solid #261D18 borders and surface value shifts.

rules.name: The Heading-Leads Rule
rules.body: Never place tiny uppercase kicker/eyebrow labels above section or product headings; place island coordinates, SKUs, and timestamps inline beside or below the heading.

dos: Do keep 0px sharp corners across all imagery, buttons, cards, and form controls.
Do preserve white-space: nowrap on single-row navigation links and font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on every price, quantity, and metric.
Do pair Libre Caslon italic headings with tracked uppercase Archivo actions and Courier Prime metadata.
donts: Don't add eyebrow/kicker labels above headings or 01 / 02 decorative numbering.
Don't replace crisp inline geometric SVG icons with emoji or Unicode glyph shortcuts.
Don't introduce drop shadows, rounded pill cards, or gradient text anywhere on the canvas.
